title: CNTK GitHub Repository Goes Public
summary: Microsoft's CNTK project history records that the CNTK repository on GitHub went public on January 25, 2016, together with a new CNTK website.
significance: A primary-source, day-precision public-availability milestone for CNTK that can be recorded without treating the date as the toolkit's invention, development start, or system birth.

verification.note: Microsoft's official CNTK project history explicitly records '2016-01-25 13:00 GMT. CNTK new repository in GitHub went public' and notes that the CNTK website became available at the same time. A Microsoft Research post published June 10, 2016 independently states that earlier in 2016 Microsoft made its open-source Computational Network Toolkit available on GitHub. This candidate is limited to the GitHub-public milestone and does not infer an invention/system-birth date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or unsupported relationship.

sources.title: Microsoft improves programming flexibility of its AI toolkit

candidateMeta.admissionReason: Microsoft's official project history establishes a day-precision GitHub-public milestone, and Microsoft Research independently corroborates that CNTK was made available on GitHub earlier in 2016. The evidence supports public availability, not an invention or system-birth date.
